description:
**Phase E — Compaction orchestration. Deps: opi-ixp.47, opi-ixp.48, E3 (opi-ixp.22).**

When `Agent.Session` has a `coder_session` set, it builds each turn's LLM context by calling `Coder.Session.build_session_context/1` (opi-ixp.48) and piping the result through `Coder.Session.Messages.to_llm/1` (E3, opi-ixp.22). This gives prompt assembly the post-compaction kept-window with the synthetic summary at the head, derived live from the SessionManager DAG — compaction never rewrites the message log, only sets a boundary that prompt assembly respects.

When no `coder_session` is attached, Session falls back to `MessageLog.to_list/1` so the Agent app stays runnable standalone.

The change lands inside Session's per-turn context-assembly helper (the one that produces `%AIContext{messages: ...}` to hand to a Loop Task — see opi-ixp.47).

Tests: integration test that, after a `CompactionEntry` is appended to the bound `Coder.Session`'s `SessionManager`, the next turn's `AIContext.messages` reflects the kept window with the synthetic `CompactionSummaryMessage` at the head.
title: E5a. Per-turn prompt assembly via Coder.Session.build_session_context/1
